definitions.explanation: The ability to perceive flavors through taste buds on the tongue. One of the five senses.

examples.japanese: {味覚|みかく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ともに→ともに：03468_tomoni⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The sense of taste can change with age.

examples.japanese: {味覚|みかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{敏感|びんかん}→敏感：06641_binkan⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理人|りょうりにん}→料理人：19396_ryourinin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧。
examples.english: People with a sensitive sense of taste are suited to be chefs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{味覚|みかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おかしく→おかしい：00875_okashii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My sense of taste became strange due to a cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{味覚|みかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧な⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{好|す}き{嫌|きら}い→好き嫌い：12206_sukikirai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Children are still developing their sense of taste, so they tend to be picky eaters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味覚|みかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦ために→ために：28332_tameni⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{栗|くり}→栗：04387_kuri⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}い→拾う：00845_hirou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: To enjoy the flavors of autumn, we went out chestnut picking as a family.
examples.notes: 味覚 is used figuratively here to mean seasonal delicacies

notes:
{味覚|みかく} refers to the sense of taste.

Basic tastes recognized in Japanese:
- ⟦{甘味|あまみ}→甘味：07017_amami⟧ (sweetness)
- ⟦{塩味|しおあじ}→塩味：12106_shioaji⟧/⟦{塩味|えんみ}→塩味：12106_shioaji⟧ (saltiness)
- ⟦{酸味|さんみ}→酸味：07016_sanmi⟧ (sourness)
- ⟦{苦味|にがみ}→苦味：14101_nigami⟧ (bitterness)
- ⟦うま{味|み}→うま味：06998_umami⟧ (umami - savory taste)

Common expressions:
- {味覚|みかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧ (to have a developed sense of taste)
- {味覚|みかく}⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧ (taste disorder)
- ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味覚|みかく} (autumn's flavors - seasonal foods)

Note:
Japan is credited with identifying ⟦うま{味|み}→うま味：06998_umami⟧ as the fifth basic taste. {味覚|みかく} is also used figuratively in expressions like 「⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味覚|みかく}」 meaning autumn's delicacies (chestnuts, persimmons, sanma, etc.).
